boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct Texas A&M Libraries study environments, spanning quiet individual work, collaborative rooms, archival research, and technology-supported projects.

cards.entity_name: Evans Library Third-Floor Individual Study Rooms
cards.title: Evans third-floor individual rooms
cards.subtitle: Sterling C. Evans Library · reservable quiet floor
cards.notes: Reserve an individual room for focused work; keep calls, video chat, and speakers outside the room, then bring your own charged devices.
cards.short_summary: A reservable individual-work option on Evans Library’s quiet third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Evans Library’s third floor is a quiet floor with open study space and 82 reservable individual study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Individual rooms are for quiet individual study; third-floor rooms may be reserved up to a week ahead for up to eight hours per day by current students, staff, and faculty.

cards.entity_name: Evans Library Fifth-Floor Quiet Study Space
cards.title: Evans fifth-floor quiet study
cards.subtitle: Sterling C. Evans Library · open quiet floor
cards.notes: Settle into the open fifth-floor study area for solo coursework; silence devices and save conversations or video calls for another space.
cards.short_summary: Open quiet study space on the fifth floor of Evans Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Evans Library’s fifth floor is a quiet floor with open study space.
cards.access_notes: Quiet-space rules prohibit talking, cell phone use, video chat, and speakers.

cards.title: Evans first-floor study pods
cards.subtitle: Sterling C. Evans Library · desk-and-power pods
cards.notes: Use a first-floor pod when you need a compact desk setup; two pods can be reserved, while one remains a walk-up option.
cards.short_summary: Three freestanding study pods with seating, desks, and power outlets.
cards.evidence_claim: Evans Library has three first-floor freestanding study pods with seating, desks, and power outlets; two are reservable.
cards.access_notes: Two of the three first-floor study pods are reservable; confirm availability through the Libraries reservation link.

cards.entity_name: Evans Annex Fifth-Floor Quiet Study Space
cards.title: Evans Annex fifth-floor quiet space
cards.subtitle: Evans Annex · open quiet floor with computers
cards.notes: Bring a task that benefits from open quiet seating or an OAL computer, and keep audio muted to respect the floor’s quiet designation.
cards.short_summary: Open quiet-floor study space in the Evans Annex with OAL computers.
cards.evidence_claim: The fifth floor of the Evans Annex is a quiet floor with open study space and OAL computers.
cards.access_notes: Quiet-space rules prohibit talking, cell phone use, video chat, and speakers.

cards.entity_name: West Campus Library Third-Floor Quiet Study Space
cards.title: West Campus Library third-floor quiet space
cards.subtitle: West Campus Library · open quiet floor with computers
cards.notes: Use the third floor for quiet coursework when you need open seating and an OAL computer; choose a group room elsewhere for discussion.
cards.short_summary: Quiet open study space with OAL computers at West Campus Library.
cards.evidence_claim: West Campus Library’s third floor is a quiet floor with open study space and OAL computers.
cards.access_notes: Quiet-space rules prohibit talking, cell phone use, video chat, and speakers.

cards.title: Kelsey Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Cushing Memorial Library & Archives · second floor
cards.notes: Request Cushing collection materials before heading over, then use the reading room’s quiet seating and OAL computers for concentrated research.
cards.short_summary: A 38-seat archival reading room that also permits quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Cushing’s second-floor Kelsey Reading Room is available for researchers using collection materials and as a quiet study space; it has 38 seats and two OAL computers.
cards.access_notes: Available to researchers using Cushing Memorial Library & Archives collection materials and for quiet study.

cards.entity_name: Medical Sciences Library Second-Floor Individual Study Rooms
cards.title: Medical Sciences Library individual rooms
cards.subtitle: Medical Sciences Library · second-floor quiet floor
cards.notes: Reserve a one-person room for uninterrupted work and use the desk, outlet, and whiteboard; keep calls and speaker audio outside.
cards.short_summary: Twenty-nine reservable individual rooms on the Medical Sciences Library’s quiet second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Medical Sciences Library has 29 reservable individual study rooms on its second-floor quiet floor, with desks, chairs, outlets, and whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Spaces - College Station | Medical Sciences Library
cards.access_notes: Individual rooms are for one-person quiet work; talking, phone use, video chat, and speakers are not allowed.

cards.title: Evans Library group study rooms
cards.subtitle: Sterling C. Evans Library · first through fourth floors
cards.notes: Reserve this option for two or more people working together; bring a shared plan and use the table, whiteboard, and available monitors.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative rooms across four Evans Library floors, with rooms sized for groups of up to 14.
cards.evidence_claim: Evans Library group study rooms are on floors one through four and include tables, chairs, and whiteboards; some first- and second-floor rooms have wall monitors.
cards.access_notes: For collaborative activity by groups of two or more; reservations may be made up to a week ahead for up to four hours per day.

cards.entity_name: West Campus Library Group Study Rooms
cards.title: West Campus Library group rooms
cards.subtitle: West Campus Library · second and third floors
cards.notes: Coordinate with your group before reserving, then use the room’s table, whiteboard, OAL computer, and—where available—large monitor.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative rooms on the second and third floors of West Campus Library.
cards.evidence_claim: West Campus Library group study rooms are on the second and third floors and include tables, chairs, whiteboards, and OAL computers; some have large monitors.
cards.access_notes: Group rooms are intended for two or more collaborators. The West Campus policy limits a single reservation to three hours and requires two members to check in.

cards.title: Graduate & Professional Student Zone
cards.subtitle: Medical Sciences Library · first floor
cards.notes: If your degree program has GPS access, use its mix of individual and group rooms, OAL computers, and seating styles for research sessions.
cards.short_summary: A swipe-access graduate study zone with rooms, computers, and varied seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Medical Sciences Library’s GPS Zone has group and individual study rooms, OAL computers, and soft, bar-height, and task seating; study rooms are first-come, first-served.
cards.access_notes: Swipe access is limited to eligible graduate students in specified degree programs; it is generally 24/7 except on home game days and during the winter holiday.
